# Soil Feedback & Messaging Requirements Quality Checklist: Playable Compost Loop

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and edge-case coverage for soil health application, visual feedback, and player messaging in the playable compost loop.
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the prerequisites for what constitutes a "valid, improvable tile" comprehensively defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK002 Are the requirements for player compost consumption explicit regarding single-item decrement per application action? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK003 Are the visual indicator activation and rendering lifecycles specified when toggling the soil health display setting? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011, Scenario 3.4]
- [x] CHK004 Is the persistence and re-render lifecycle of visual tile differentiation specified across game save, reload, and day-advance transitions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §FR-012]

## Visual Distinction & Feedback Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is "visually distinguishable" defined with objective visual properties (e.g. tint, overlay, texture, or sprite alteration) rather than subjective appearance? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK006 Is the spatial resolution and alignment of the visual feedback specified (e.g. individual tile grid alignment vs radius)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK007 Does the specification quantify how multiple levels of soil health improvement are visually differentiated across the 0–100 scale? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK008 Are the visual feedback requirements explicitly bounded during adverse rendering conditions such as night, winter, or rain? [Clarity, Edge Case, Spec §FR-010]

## Error & Refusal Messaging Specification

- [x] CHK009 Are the exact textual strings or message keys for every refusal reason specified for localized native on-screen display? [Clarity, Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §FR-008a]
- [x] CHK010 Are native on-screen message presentation attributes (HUD message type, duration, icon, or sound cue) explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008a]
- [x] CHK011 Does the specification define distinct refusal messages for each failure condition (e.g. untilled tile, non-farmable surface, max health reached, concurrent action conflict)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, §FR-008a, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK012 Is the prohibition against custom UI dialogs, popups, or bespoke text components explicitly verified against all messaging paths? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008a]

## Tile State Boundaries & Clamping

- [x] CHK013 Is the exact incremental value added to soil health per compost application explicitly specified? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK014 Is the clamping behavior at the upper boundary (100) unambiguously specified as a refusal vs partial consumption? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009, Scenario 3.2]
- [x] CHK015 Are lower boundary conditions (health value 0) and default unaugmented baseline states defined regarding visual reporting? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK016 Can the requirement that 100% of observed soil health values remain within 0 to 100 inclusive be objectively verified across repeated applications? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009, §SC-003]

## Edge Cases & Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are refusal and visual suppression requirements defined when applying compost to tiles with active growing crops or dead crops? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK018 Are messaging and state refusal requirements specified for indoor farming locations (e.g. Greenhouse, garden pots)? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK019 Are concurrent player action conflicts on the same tile specified with deterministic first-actor-wins and second-actor notification behavior? [Coverage, Consistency, Spec §FR-019, §SC-010]
- [x] CHK020 Are failure response and error isolation requirements specified so that a visual rendering failure does not block gameplay or leak raw exceptions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §FR-014, §FR-015]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
